steps.caption: Competitor Intel
steps.narration: This is Competitor Intel. It looks up the businesses Google lists for your trade around your town.

steps.caption: Your trade
steps.narration: Choose your trade from the list, from roofing and siding to HVAC and plumbing.

steps.caption: City or address
steps.narration: Then enter a city or an address for the area you want to see.

steps.caption: Search radius
steps.narration: Under Advanced, set the radius: 10, 25, 50 or 100 miles.

steps.caption: Scan market
steps.narration: Scan market reads Google's public listings. Each scan uses one from your monthly allowance.

steps.caption: Saved scans
steps.narration: Every scan is saved to your account. This one found twelve roofing contractors within 25 miles of Denver.

steps.caption: Open the scan
steps.narration: Open it to see the market.

steps.caption: Businesses by signal band
steps.narration: The top row counts the businesses, and how many show few, some or more review signals.

steps.caption: The overview
steps.narration: The overview names the best-rated listings, with their rating and review count.

steps.caption: Every listing
steps.narration: Each business shows its rating, review count and category, with links to call it or open its website.

steps.caption: BS Meter, with its reasons
steps.narration: The BS Meter scores signals worth a closer look, from 0 to 100, and lists every reason, like a keyword-stuffed name.

steps.caption: Review analysis
steps.narration: Review analysis breaks down the sample of reviews Google returns for that listing.

steps.caption: Signals, not proof
steps.narration: Good and bad reviews, common phrases and generic wording. They're signals to look at, not proof.

steps.caption: Menu: Competitor Intel
steps.narration: You'll find Competitor Intel in the menu on the left, under Tools.

youtube.title: Competitor Intel in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Competitor Intel in ConstructHUB: pick your trade and area, then read a saved scan of the businesses Google lists around you, with ratings, review counts, the BS Meter and a review-sample breakdown.
